sense: the named errors filed for this style
definition: The named errors as they bear on this style: first those where it has an exception or a severity of its own, then those written for it, its ancestors or its family, then a count of those that apply to every house.
basis: Editorial. mcp_server/core.py: "Faults are element-first: most are universal, and style is a facet." A fault reaches "A style and everything it inherits from, as a set.", and a style's own exception is read before it is published, as in "EXCEPTION_FOR_THIS_STYLE (the licence is EARNED)" and its two siblings. VISION.md: "Style enters as an exception, and the exceptions matter as much as the rules."

surface.what: The named errors as they bear on this style.
read: First come the errors where this style has an exception, earned or not, or a severity of its own.
Then come the errors written for this style, its ancestors or its family.
The errors that apply to every house are counted, with a link to the library narrowed to this style.
A tradition or a family is not built, so errors about a whole house are not counted for one.
